exampleSentence: The mechanic kept every scrap of metal in a wooden box.
exampleTranslation: 机修工把每一块金属碎片都留在一个木箱里。

exampleSentence: He scraped the mud off his boots before entering the house.
exampleTranslation: 进屋前，他刮掉了靴子上的泥。

exampleSentence: The cat scratched my arm while I was holding it.
exampleTranslation: 我抱着那只猫时，它抓伤了我的手臂。

exampleSentence: She screamed when the door suddenly opened.
exampleTranslation: 门突然打开时，她尖叫了起来。

exampleSentence: The words on the screen were too small to read.
exampleTranslation: 屏幕上的字太小了，看不清。

exampleSentence: The shelf fell because one screw was missing.
exampleTranslation: 架子掉了下来，因为少了一颗螺丝。

exampleSentence: The actors rehearsed the script before filming began.
exampleTranslation: 演员们在开拍前排练了剧本。

exampleSentence: The priest read a passage from scripture during the service.
exampleTranslation: 牧师在礼拜期间朗读了一段经文。

exampleSentence: She scrubbed the kitchen floor until it shone.
exampleTranslation: 她把厨房地板擦洗得闪闪发亮。

exampleSentence: The proposal came under close scrutiny from the committee.
exampleTranslation: 该提案受到了委员会的严格审查。

exampleSentence: The museum placed the marble sculpture near the entrance.
exampleTranslation: 博物馆把这座大理石雕塑放在入口附近。

exampleSentence: The sea was calm when we sailed out of the bay.
exampleTranslation: 我们驶出海湾时，海面很平静。

exampleSentence: She sealed the envelope before mailing it.
exampleTranslation: 她把信封封好后才寄出去。

exampleSentence: The seam on the sleeve was beginning to come apart.
exampleTranslation: 袖子上的接缝开始裂开了。

exampleSentence: The city grew into a busy seaport over the next century.
exampleTranslation: 这座城市在接下来的一个世纪里发展成了繁忙的海港城市。

exampleSentence: The police searched the area for the missing child.
exampleTranslation: 警方在该地区搜寻失踪的孩子。

exampleSentence: He found an empty seat near the window.
exampleTranslation: 他在窗边找到了一个空座位。

exampleSentence: This is the second time she has called today.
exampleTranslation: 这是她今天第二次打电话来。

exampleSentence: The plan is affordable and, secondly, easy to carry out.
exampleTranslation: 这个计划负担得起，其次也容易实施。

exampleSentence: She kept the secret for nearly twenty years.
exampleTranslation: 她把这个秘密保守了将近二十年。

exampleSentence: The secretary arranged the meeting and sent the invitations.
exampleTranslation: 秘书安排了会议并发送了邀请函。

exampleSentence: This section of the report describes the new policy.
exampleTranslation: 报告的这一部分介绍了新政策。

exampleSentence: The tourism sector provides many jobs in the region.
exampleTranslation: 旅游业为该地区提供了许多工作岗位。

exampleSentence: The company invests heavily in data security.
exampleTranslation: 这家公司大力投资数据安全。

exampleSentence: I can see the mountains from my bedroom window.
exampleTranslation: 我从卧室窗户能看见那些山。
